I travel a lot—bouncing between countries—so for a while, I neglected getting my hair done. I’d enquired in several countries, but no salon ever felt quite right, so I never followed through with an appointment. That changed when I arrived in Asunción and decided it was time to prioritise my hair health again.

I had a special request for a private room as I wear a hijab, and while many salons claim to accommodate hijabi clients, it’s often treated like an inconvenience. That wasn’t the case here. I reached out to Bellissima and spoke with Jazmin, who was exceptionally kind, welcoming, and made me feel totally comfortable right from the first message.

The prices were super clear and reasonable—and honestly, after seeing the results, it was worth every single cent.

My colourist was Dolores, and although I only speak a few words of Spanish, she made me feel completely at ease and genuinely understood. I showed her an inspo pic and described my desired outcome—and not only did she match it perfectly, the final result was even better.

She matched my natural colour for lowlights and added the most beautifully placed highlights. This woman is a master. She removed the lightener section by section to avoid any over-processing—it was so strategic and precise. Her attention to detail is next-level. She’s not just a colourist, she’s a true artist and craftsman. Her assistant was equally sweet and caring—it honestly felt like a loved one was doing my hair, that’s how much heart they put into their work.

Dolores also did a root shadow and toned everything to absolute perfection. She gave a thorough scalp cleanse too (which was so satisfying). When it came to the cut, I told her to do whatever she felt was right—and she didn’t go overboard like many stylists do. She trimmed only what was needed. I trusted her completely, and she honored that trust with such grace.

It took me 6–7 countries to find someone like her. And while I’ve been to award-winning salons before, Dolores is on another level. My husband even commented that he’d never seen a hairdresser care for every single section and strand the way she did.

This is hands-down the best hair colour I’ve had in 15 years.

If you’re in Asunción, please visit this salon. They’re amazing, respectful, professional, and so, so hardworking. They truly deserve wonderful clients—and I will absolutely be returning.

I visited this clinic twice, and I want to share my honest experience.

On the first visit, I did almost the whole body and paid 1,000,000 Gs. This seemed like a fair price, and everything went smoothly. The location is very convenient, the atmosphere is welcoming, and they even offer drinks at the entrance, which is a nice touch. The specialist who carried out the procedure was very kind, attentive, and laser machine they use is really effective too. The reception staff were also friendly. Overall, my first impression was very positive.

However, my second visit left me disappointed. This time, I was charged 100,000 Gs more than on my first visit for the same areas, even though I actually decided to skip some zones on my face. When I asked for a refund for the areas I didn’t do, the reception first told me the amount would be applied to my next session. So the receptionist basically admitted that there should be some form of compensation. But instead of offering me a proper choice, she tried to push me into a “credit” for the future.

I insisted on a proper refund and they told me to wait first but later told me that the missed zones were “free” due to a promotion (“pay for one area, get another for free”) and therefore no refund was due. But this explanation didn’t make sense: if there really was such a promotion, then by not doing the face zones I should have received other zones for free instead, which would mean my total should have been less, not more. On top of that, they first gave me a detailed factura showing each procedure, but then took it back and reprinted a different version. This only reinforced my impression that the process was not transparent.

At the end of the day, I feel scammed. I loved the clinic at first — the location, the atmosphere, the kind specialist — but because of this billing issue and the way my request was handled, I lost trust. when you go to a place like this, the last thing you expect is to argue about prices or feel scammed.

Minutes later, when the receptionist arrived, I asked her why the requested service hadn't been properly communicated to her. She explained that, before starting, the professional should ask the client what service they want. I clarified that the professional never asked me what I wanted. In response, I was offered a discount, which ultimately amounted to 20%.

In conclusion:
1- There is a clear lack of communication among the employees.

2- The person who attended to me admitted not knowing what service I had requested and, even so, didn't ask me anything and proceeded to perform a service I hadn't asked for.

3- Despite the discount offered, I ended up paying for a service I DID NOT REQUEST and which, given the condition of my feet, is COMPLETELY UNNECESSARY.
